description: `updateCluster`'s `resultCacheDefaultVisibilitySeconds` must be sent as JSON `null` to turn the result cache off: a PATCH with `resultCacheEnabled: false` and the field absent keeps the stored visibility and fails with 400 "resultsCacheDefaultVisibilitySeconds must be empty when resultCacheEnabled is false", while the same PATCH with the field `null` succeeds (live calls, 2026-11-12). Galaxy's Terraform provider sends `null` for the same reason. Marking the member nullable lets callers send `null`.
